Dr. Elena Ruiz provided a food safety and delivery review noting that the temporary food-service permit is pending, temperature control tests passed for 75 minutes against a 55-minute route, and delivery resilience requires a backup driver plan before launch.

Noah Brooks provided a kitchen and volunteer update stating that Riverside Community Kitchen is available Wednesdays with final paperwork pending and an insurance certificate required before cooking. Four volunteers are signed up, but a backup-driver plan may be needed.

Priya Shah's customer research report details the estimated meal cost breakdown totaling $9.30 per meal and notes resident price expectations of $12 to $15, while service area, menu rotation, meal price, and delivery inclusion remain open decisions.

Leah Morgan published the Riverside Meal Delivery Pilot Brief (v1.0) on August 18, 2026, outlining the six-week pilot serving 80 meals every Wednesday starting October 7, 2026, while identifying open choices regarding price, area, menu, and delivery coverage, as well as necessary prerequisites like kitchen access and rehearsals.
